alternatives.argument: The carrier defines the finite-dimensional exact subflows, composition order, and vector-field bracket convention directly. The existing maximal ODE existence and uniqueness supplier provides the local flow maps; no Strang-paper result is used as a definition or proof.

The carrier expands coordinate pullbacks by repeated time differentiation and the fundamental theorem of calculus. It multiplies the Lie and symmetric Strang polynomials through cubic order, computes each word coefficient, converts operator commutators to vector-field brackets using Hessian symmetry, and obtains the stated pointwise cubic Peano remainder and uniform local-order bound.

The carrier derives exact split-map stability by Gronwall and a bounded-step exponential mean-value estimate, then applies the actual batch-28 one-step global-error theorem to the locally proved Lie and Strang defects. It separately telescopes approximate subflow errors and requires a composed-map stability bound; no publisher result supplies those conclusions.
